name: Oisaki Miyuki
source:
Yuuta's mother.
She decided to move after her divorce.
She is always fighting with her daughter.
On the other hand she is always nice with Yuuta, even though she can also be tough.
As far as Yuuta is concerned, she's his loving mother, but she is more worldly wise that she shows...
